create.name: Salimah Kassim-Lakha
create.bio:
Salimah Kassim-Lakha is a Kundalini Yoga teacher, trainer and yoga therapist in Toronto, and the founder of YogaVision. She came to Kundalini Yoga at a stuck point in her working life, was encouraged by her own teacher to train, and has since logged thousands of hours of study across several yoga schools over more than twenty years. Her South Asian heritage shapes how she teaches, and she frames the practice as a lineage of breath, movement, mantra and meditation rather than a fitness routine.

Most of her teaching now reaches students online. She leads a twelve-month, 300-hour Kundalini Yoga training with rolling start dates, which covers the subtle body, yogic philosophy, pranayama and how to teach in a trauma-aware way. Harmony Within is her monthly membership for women, with a library of recorded kriyas and meditations and live group sessions, and Transform at Home is a lower-cost self-paced bundle with a 40-day meditation challenge and a chakra series. She also gives one-to-one Kundalini numerology readings. Her YouTube channel, running since 2010, holds hundreds of full-length guided Kundalini classes and meditations.

courses.title: Kundalini Yoga Training
courses.description: A twelve-month, 300-hour certified training led by Salimah with live classes, mentoring and a global student group. It moves from personal practice and breathwork through the subtle body and yogic philosophy to teaching full classes, with new groups starting most months.

courses.title: Harmony Within
courses.description: A monthly online membership for women with more than a hundred recorded Kundalini kriyas, breath practices and meditations sorted by need, four live sessions a month, a mentoring circle and a private group chat.

courses.title: Transform at Home
courses.description: A self-paced bundle with lifetime access: a 40-day meditation challenge, a series of breathing practices, a chakra series and a library of recorded Kundalini classes, plus a short numerology introduction.

courses.title: Kundalini Numerology
courses.description: A sixty-minute one-to-one consultation that reads the numbers in a person's name and birth date through Kundalini numerology, with a written report and suggested practices.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @yogavisiononline 69,700 subscribers (YouTube Data API, 12 Nov 2026); Instagram and TikTok linked but never fetched → ~70k readable → local_hero
flags: Health rule (new): her pages use wellbeing wording (nervous system, anxiety, burnout, sleep, trauma-informed) and are now in. Two kept videos name conditions as practice routines ('for PTSD', 'Random Anxiety?'), which the owner's 12 Nov rulings allow; owner may prefer to drop the PTSD one.
Photo: her YouTube channel avatar (a clear portrait). Her site's own images are on cdn.prod.website-files.com, whose robots.txt refused us (403, 12 Nov 2026), so none were used.
No published email on the pages read; contact form used.
Base: the home page says 'Based in Toronto and Online'; availability local_online assumed from that, though nearly all current offers are online.
Some subjects: numerology has no subject of its own; soul-purpose used for the reading.
left_out: Soul Compass Coaching & Yoga Therapy ($1666 / $3333 USD): one-to-one therapy-led coaching sold as 'when talk isn't enough', and her Meet Salimah page lists trauma counselling; therapy scope, and the line reads close to a 'better than talk therapy' claim.
Most-viewed video '50- min Kundalini Yoga for Emotional Healing & Hormone Balance': hormone-balance wording, replaced by the next practice video.
Meditation teacher training: named on the home page but no page URL found among the pages read.
Shop (printify merchandise), corporate wellness and family yoga: not teaching items.
